In particular, a legacy profile must display Existing Voice (migrada) plus its short disambiguator wherever the user is told which profile receives audio. Preserve persisted display_name/voice_id and all data/security behavior. Add one focused assertion if needed. Run py_compile, all tests, build_ui smoke and git diff --check. No real data workflows, dependency changes, git metadata changes, commit or push.
constraints: Canonical biel4 App Server/headless Executor only; no native subagents, create_thread, alternate backend, TUI, or direct fallback.
Edit only app.py and focused tests; do not mutate real audio/profile data.
